derivation: Race at SteppingLoop distToPhysics<distToBoundary. Winner channel w: budget n_w=numIALeft[w] ~ Exp(1) conditional on history (memoryless; sampled -log(U) zero-dot, decremented pStep/lambda pathwise). Proposed interaction distance x_p=lambda_w*n_w (gamma; electron via MSC true<->geom, local secant Jacobian r=pTrue/gStep) with pathwise dot xdot_p=dot(distToPhysics); boundary d_b with dot ddot_b (severing-stack-consistent). Margin m=d_b-x_p; reparameterized flip when m crosses 0. Conditional flip density f=(1/lambda_w)exp(-d_b/lambda_w) (electron f=(r/lambda_w)exp(-r*d_b/lambda_w)). Missing term per decision: dE[F]/dtheta += f*mdot*(F_int@bnd - F_transport@bnd), mdot=ddot_b-xdot_p. Sign: mdot>0 = boundary recedes from pending interaction = physics-win region grows; payoff difference always oriented interaction-minus-transport; with realized continuation as F_cur: contribution s*f*mdot*(E_phantom-E_real), s=+1 realized-boundary-won (phantom=interaction at boundary), s=-1 realized-physics-won (phantom=transport through boundary). Threshold states forced by numIALeft[w] <- (d_b/lambda_w)*(1 -/+ 1e-9) on a pre-step clone (transport phantom crosses with ~0 residual and interacts just past the plane = marginal transport event). Multi-channel: winner-channel flip only counts when all other channels' proposed distances exceed d_b (guard); winner-only density = documented underestimate. Documented v1 biases: realized-continuation payoff (not threshold-conditioned), continuous/MSC-limited electron races skipped, selection threshold S=f*|mdot|*EKin drops small decisions; forward-mode only.
interpretation: Wave-7 hypothesis FALSIFIED by the exact paired-threshold estimator: the boundary-vs-physics race carries no measurable branch-flip mass (budget persistence => the two branches coincide at threshold up to cross-material product differences; interaction-position sensitivity already pathwise). Mode-1 bias quantifies why phantom estimators must price BOTH branches at the threshold. Residual gap inflation must live in another mechanism class.
